lemmas.lexica: LS naturalis; Blaise malum naturale=evil as a nature

pass_b_english: Even if newborns could draw some evil from their parents, it would be cleansed by God’s hands, because he himself forms them in their mothers’ wombs.
This pronouncement exposes the emptiness of those who think nature’s depths can be comprehended by some investigation.
‘I do not know how you appeared in my womb’ (2 Maccabees 7:22).
Why are children not cleansed by the very act of their making, so that the maker’s majesty purifies them from the alleged pollutions of their parents?

choices.why: Julian's charge against Augustine: treating evil as a nature rather than as will.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied.
